verdict.rationale: Penpot's own documentation says users can "choose where and how to host it" and can run it in a private cloud, on-premise, or any environment they control. Official Docker Compose and Kubernetes/Helm deployment paths make this practical, and community users report self-hosting it successfully, so users fully control where their data lives. missing for 10: region/residency selection for the hosted SaaS instance, explicit data-residency or compliance documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Choose where and how to host it, and decide who has access to it.
Run it in your private cloud, on-premise, or any environment you control.
Use Kubernetes in its different flavors: Deploy the official Helm Chart, Deploy in Openshift, Deploy in Rancher
Have been self-hosting this on Docker/Portainer for several weeks for a few people. Works fine so far.
